title: DecodedLabel
description: Structured form of one decoded building-measurement label. Partial decoding is valid: unknown semantic fields are null, but raw_label, source_type, confidence, and validated are always required.

raw_label.description: The original label string, verbatim. Mandatory for traceability.

source_type.description: Which data universe the label came from.

carrier.description: Energy/medium carrier, inferred from keywords or codes.

function.description: Free-text role of the point, e.g. energimaaling, temperatur, settpunkt, status, kommando, utgang, inngang.

unit.description: Unit if known (kWh, °C, NOK, kg, m3...). Often absent from the label and must be inferred from data or documentation.

object_type.description: BACnet object type when source_type is bacnet. Verify against the value distribution (AV-as-binary trap).

subsystem.description: Subsystem code/description (e.g. NNN.NNN, or undernummer meaning like tur/retur, tilluft/avtrekk).

component.description: NS 3457-8 component (3-letter code) or component description, when present.

is_derived.description: True for computed/virtual series (e.g. a cost built from several price components), false for a measured quantity.

confidence.description: Calibrated overall confidence in this decoding.

reasoning.description: Short justification for the decoding, so mistakes are traceable.

data_checks.description: Optional results of cross-checking the name hypothesis against the measurement data.

temp_correlation.description: Correlation with outdoor temperature, if computed.

distinct_values.description: Count of distinct values (2 suggests binary).

monotonic.description: Whether the series is monotonically increasing (suggests a cumulative meter).

conflict.description: True if the data contradicts the name-based guess.

relationships.description: Links to other labels (same system/component/location, aggregate-of, feeds, etc.). Empty until relationship inference is added.

type.description: Relationship kind, e.g. same_system, aggregate_of, feeds.

validated.description: True only after a human has confirmed this decoding.
